concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-platforms-manage-reserve-account]] — 2026-09-15 Platforms reserve-account guide for liable-holder-linked collateral against transfer-caused negative user balances, distinct from refund/chargeback reserved compensation; request and block are not payout proof.
warnings: Reserve account is a liable-account-holder-linked balance account; distinguish it from the user's balance account and reserved compensation account for refund/chargeback negatives.

Insufficient available reserve funds cause the negative-balance transfer request to fail; collateral equal to the transfer-caused negative amount remains blocked until the user balance account receives enough compensating funds, with no fixed timing promised.
The page gives no role, currency or minimum-percentage schema; funding routes and example payouts are not completed money-movement evidence.
